verses.text: Junjun ujal tz'och 24 mil heb' winh winak t'a soldado'al. Ha t'a skal heb' winh ay heb' winh yajal yaj t'a skal yinhtilal, ay heb' winh niwak yajalil heb' soldado yet' heb' winh yajalil heb' tz'ilan tastak yik winh rey. Haton sb'i heb' winh ayoch yajalil tik, t'a stzolal tz'aj yoch heb' winh t'a junjun uj.
Ha t'a b'ab'el uj ha winhaj Jasobeam yuninal winhaj Zabdiel yinhtilal winhaj Fares tz'ochi.
Haxo t'a schab'il uj, ha winhaj Dodai aj Aho tz'ochi. Haxo winhaj Miclot schab'il yajal yaji.
Haxo t'a yoxil uj, ha winhaj Benaía yuninal winhaj sat sacerdote Joiada tz'ochi.
Ha winhaj Benaía chi', yajal yaj winh t'a 30 heb' soldado te b'inajnak, haxo winh yuninal winh skuchan Amisabad, schab'il yajal yaj winh t'a jun makan heb' soldado tz'och t'a jun uj chi'.
Haxo t'a schanhil uj, ha winhaj Asael yuktak winhaj Joab aykanoch sb'i t'ay, palta haxo winhaj Zebadías yuninal winh ayoch yajalil sk'exulok.
Haxo t'a yo'il uj, ha winhaj Samhut yinhtilal Izhar tz'ochi.
Haxo t'a swakil uj, ha winhaj Ira yuninal winhaj Iques aj Tecoa tz'ochi.
Haxo t'a yukil uj, ha winhaj Heles aj Pelón, yinhtilal Efraín tz'ochi.
Haxo t'a swajxakil uj, ha winhaj Sibecai aj Husa, yinhtilal winhaj Zera tz'ochi.
Haxo t'a sb'alunhil uj, ha winhaj Abiezer aj Anatot, yinhtilal Benjamín tz'ochi.
Haxo t'a slajunhil uj, ha winhaj Maharai aj Netofa, yinhtilal winhaj Zera tz'ochi.
Haxo t'a yuxluchil uj, ha winhaj Benaía aj Piratón, yinhtilal Efraín tz'ochi.
Haxo t'a slajchawil uj, ha winhaj Heldai aj Netofa, yinhtilal winhaj Otoniel tz'ochi.

Haxo pax heb' winh yajal yaj t'a junjun makan heb' yinhtilal Israel, haton heb' winh tik: Ha t'a heb' yinhtilal Rubén, ha winhaj Eliezer yuninal winhaj Zicri yajal yaji. Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilal Simeón, ha winhaj Sefatías yuninal winhaj Maaca yajal yaji. Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilal Leví, ha winhaj Hasabías yuninal winhaj Kemuel yajal yaji. Haxo t'a heb' winh yinhtilal winhaj Aarón, ha winhaj Sadoc yajal yaji. Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilal Judá, ha winhaj Eliú yuktak winhaj rey David yajal yaji. Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilal Isacar, ha winhaj Omri yuninal winhaj Micael yajal yaji. Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilal Zabulón, ha winhaj Ismaías yuninal winhaj Abdías yajal yaji. Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilal Neftalí, ha winhaj Jerimot yuninal winhaj Azriel yajal yaji. Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilal Efraín, ha winhaj Oseas yuninal winhaj Azazías yajal yaji. Ha t'a nanhal heb' yinhtilal Manasés, ha winhaj Joel yuninal winhaj Pedaías yajal yaji. Haxo t'a nanhalxo heb' yinhtilal Manasés ay t'a Galaad, ha winhaj Iddo yuninal winhaj Zacarías yajal yaji. Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilal Benjamín, ha winhaj Jaasiel yuninal winhaj Abner yajal yaji. Haxo t'a heb' yinhtilal Dan, ha winhaj Azareel yuninal winhaj Jeroham yajal yaji. Haton juntzanh heb' winh tik yajal yaj t'a junjun makan heb' yinhtilal Israel.

Ayik ix yalan winhaj rey David to sb'ischaj masanil heb' israel, ix yalan winh to max b'ischajlaj heb' manto tz'akwi t'a 20 ab'il sk'inal, yujto yak'nak sti' Jehová to ol yik' wal cha'anh sb'isul heb' yinhtilal Israel icha sb'isul k'e'en k'anal.

Ix scha'el yich winhaj Joab yik'ancha'anh sb'isul heb' yetisraelal chi', palta maj lajwoklaj yik'ancha'anh winh, yujto yuj jun chi' ix kot jun niwan yahelal t'a yib'anh chonhab' Israel. Yuj chi' ha sb'isul heb' chi' manh tz'ib'ab'ilok t'a yab'ixal winhaj rey David.

Ha winhaj Azmavet yuninal winhaj Adiel tz'ilan tastak ay t'a winh rey. Haxo winhaj Jonatán yuninal winhaj Uzías tz'ilani jantak tas molan t'a junjun chonhab', t'a junjun aldea yet' t'a junjun cuartel ay t'a sattak mojon.
Haxo winhaj Ezri yuninal winhaj Quelub tz'ilan heb' smunlaj t'a slu'um winh rey chi'.
Haxo winhaj Simei aj Ramat tz'ilan heb' smunlaj t'a te' yuwa winh rey chi'. Haxo winhaj Zabdi aj Safat tz'ilan heb' smolb'an wino t'a yet'tal.
Haxo winhaj Baal-hanán aj Gedera tz'ilan heb' smunlaj t'a te' olivo yet' t'a te' kaltakte'al higo ay t'a panhkiltak. Haxo winhaj Joás tz'ilan heb' smolan aceite yik sat te' olivo.
Haxo winhaj Sitrai aj Sarón tz'ilan heb' ayoch yil nok' wakax ay t'a Sarón chi'. Haxo pax winhaj Safat yuninal winhaj Adlai tz'ilan heb' ayoch yil nok' wakax ay t'a panhkiltak.
Haxo winhaj Obil ismaelita tz'ilan heb' ayoch yil nok' camello. Haxo winhaj Jehedías aj Meronot tz'ilan heb' ayoch yil nok' b'uru.
Haxo winhaj Jaziz agareno tz'ilan heb' ayoch yil nok' kalnel yet' nok' chiwa. Haton masanil heb' winh tik tz'ilan masanil tastak ay t'a winhaj rey David chi'.

Ha winhaj Jonatán yicham winhaj rey David chi', tz'ib'um winh, te jelan pax winh, ak'um razón yaj winh t'a winh rey chi'. Haxo winhaj Jehiel yuninal winhaj Hacmoni tz'ilan heb' winh yuninal winh rey chi'.
Yet' pax winhaj Ahitofel ak'um razón yajpax winh t'a winh rey chi' yet' winhaj Husai arquita, te wach' yak'an winh rey chi' yet' winh.
Ayik toxo ix cham winhaj Ahitofel chi', ha winhaj Joiada yuninal winhaj Benaía yet' winhaj Abiatar ix ochkan sk'exulok winh. Haxo winhaj Joab sat yajal yaj t'a heb' soldado winh rey chi'.
